purpose: Publisher reference for the current six read-only MCP tools. Copy each justification into the matching annotation field after scanning the deployed server; this artifact is not proof of portal submission or approval.

readOnlyHint.justification: GET /v1/wallets/{wallet_id} through the internal API binding. Reads one permitted wallet record and its balance. No application-state mutation is performed.

openWorldHint.justification: The wallet identifier is validated and used only in a fixed internal PayAgentic API path; the tool cannot call user-supplied URLs or external payment destinations.

destructiveHint.justification: It cannot debit, credit, fund or change the selected wallet.

readOnlyHint.justification: GET /v1/policies through the internal API binding. Reads existing spending-policy records. No application-state mutation is performed.

openWorldHint.justification: It queries only the fixed internal PayAgentic policies collection under the caller's API authorization; it cannot browse external services.

destructiveHint.justification: It cannot create, edit, enable, disable or delete policies.

readOnlyHint.justification: GET /v1/transactions through the internal API binding. Reads recorded transaction activity. No application-state mutation is performed.

openWorldHint.justification: It queries only the fixed internal PayAgentic transactions collection under the caller's API authorization; it cannot interact with external recipients or merchants.

destructiveHint.justification: It cannot initiate, cancel, reverse or refund a transaction.

readOnlyHint.justification: GET /v1/wallets through the internal API binding. Reads permitted wallet records, optionally filtered by an allowlisted chain name. No application-state mutation is performed.

openWorldHint.justification: It queries only the fixed internal PayAgentic wallets collection with a validated chain filter; it cannot connect to arbitrary hosts or blockchain destinations.

destructiveHint.justification: It cannot create, modify, delete or fund wallets.

readOnlyHint.justification: GET /v1/agents through the internal API binding. Reads existing agent records and their status. No application-state mutation is performed.

openWorldHint.justification: It queries only the fixed internal PayAgentic agents collection under the caller's API authorization; it does not execute agents or contact their external services.

destructiveHint.justification: It cannot create, execute, reconfigure or remove an agent.

readOnlyHint.justification: GET /v1/approvals through the internal API binding. Reads approval requests and their current status. No application-state mutation is performed.

openWorldHint.justification: It queries only the fixed internal PayAgentic approvals collection under the caller's API authorization; it cannot send requests or decisions to external parties.

destructiveHint.justification: It cannot approve, deny, cancel or otherwise modify a request.
